mcqs.question: What is the stated objective of the Andhra Pradesh Drone Corporation’s drone-sector initiatives?
options: To make Andhra Pradesh the ‘Drone Capital of India’
To establish Andhra Pradesh as the ‘Drone Capital of Asia’
To make Andhra Pradesh the ‘Space Capital of India’
To develop Andhra Pradesh as the ‘Defence Capital of India’
mcqs.explanation: The objective is to make Andhra Pradesh the ‘Drone Capital of India’. The other options alter the stated sector or geographical scope of the objective.

mcqs.question: Which organisation was identified as the nodal agency for Andhra Pradesh’s drone-sector initiatives, and how many use cases had it identified?
mcqs.explanation: The A.P. Drone Corporation is the nodal agency and had identified 100+ use cases. The other options either change the number of use cases or incorrectly identify the agency.
